MAGNETIC_DRAW.name: Magnetic Draw
MAGNETIC_DRAW.headline: People notice you — often before you've said a word.
MAGNETIC_DRAW.body: You carry a natural charisma that draws others in. This isn't performative; it's a quiet gravity. People remember you, and they want to be around you.
MAGNETIC_DRAW.advice: Use this pull responsibly. Let people in, but don't collect them. Depth beats volume.

RESTLESS_FEET.name: Restless Feet
RESTLESS_FEET.headline: You are wired for movement.
RESTLESS_FEET.body: Staying in one place — physically or mentally — wears you down. You thrive when you're traveling, exploring, or constantly learning something new.
RESTLESS_FEET.advice: Build movement into your life intentionally. If you can't travel, change your routine.

SOLITARY_DEPTH.name: Solitary Depth
SOLITARY_DEPTH.headline: You have a rich inner world that few get to see.
SOLITARY_DEPTH.body: You are drawn to quiet, introspection, and solitary pursuits. Your creativity and insight come from this deep well. It's not loneliness — it's space.
SOLITARY_DEPTH.advice: Protect your alone time. It's not a luxury; it's your source of power.

ALLY_MAGNET.name: Ally Magnet
ALLY_MAGNET.headline: You attract people who want to help you.
ALLY_MAGNET.body: You naturally draw in mentors, allies, and supporters. When you're in trouble, help arrives from unexpected places. This is a rare and valuable gift.
ALLY_MAGNET.advice: Accept help gracefully. You don't have to do everything alone.

SCHOLAR_MIND.name: Scholar Mind
SCHOLAR_MIND.headline: You have a natural hunger for knowledge.
SCHOLAR_MIND.body: You process information deeply and love learning for its own sake. You are at your best when you're studying, writing, or teaching others.
SCHOLAR_MIND.advice: Never stop learning. Your mind is your greatest asset.

SHARP_EDGE.name: Sharp Edge
SHARP_EDGE.headline: You have a competitive, unyielding drive.
SHARP_EDGE.body: You are ambitious, competitive, and fiercely independent. When you decide to win, you don't stop. This is a double-edged sword — it can burn you out if you don't pace yourself.
SHARP_EDGE.advice: Direct your intensity toward your goals, not against yourself.

COMMANDER.name: Commander
COMMANDER.headline: You are a natural leader with a strong moral compass.
COMMANDER.body: You take charge when others hesitate. You have a strong sense of justice and aren't afraid to make tough decisions. People look to you when things get hard.
COMMANDER.advice: Lead with empathy. Strength without kindness becomes isolation.
